reason: Its third parameter and two of its assertions were the profile a word list chose per query (QueryAnalysis.recommended_profile) and one intent read from words; this change removes both on purpose (docs/research/2026-11-17-every-search-runs-every-leg.md), so no query carries a profile to assert. The test keeps the same queries but one, still asserts determinism, and now asserts the exact intent tuple of each, which is stricter than the old 'intent in intents'. The dropped case was the Russian wording of 'What is the auth decision?', which law 10 forbids in the repository; its Chinese twin stays.
